response.sql: WITH filtered_telescopes AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.pointaccarc, t.bandusagepct, o.weathprofile FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86), group_stats AS (SELECT observstation, weathprofile, AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM filtered_telescopes GROUP BY observstation, weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as overall_avg_bandwidth, AVG(telescope_count) as overall_avg_count FROM group_stats;
